data.text:
Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Sec. Vince Dizon vented his anger at DPWH engineers who took over the Sunog Apog Pumping Station in Manila on Wednesday, September 24. The project, funded in 2017 for ₱774 million, constructed in 2018, and inaugurated in 2020, has not been fully operational since then.

The pumping station received an additional ₱94 million budget this year to make it operational, but DPWH engineers said ₱200 million more is needed to ensure it becomes fully functional. The DPWH Secretary has ordered a halt to its rehabilitation pending a full assessment of the project.

Barangay officials said they never needed the pumping station in the first place, claiming they were not consulted before construction began. Independent Commission for Infrastructure investigator and Baguio Mayor Benjamin Magalong, together with Manila Mayor Isko Moreno, accompanied Sec. Dizon during the inspection. | via Raffy Tima/GMA Integrated News
